name: W London-Leicester Square
positioning: W London, a Soho hotel overlooking Leicester Square, the West End and Chinatown, with rooms by artist Jack Irving, a private screening room and AWAY Spa
best_for: Theatre and nightlife lovers who want to walk everywhere in the West End
Design-minded travelers who like playful rooms and in-house film nights

facts.text: The hotel is at 10 Wardour Street, in the heart of Soho.
The hotel is a short walk from Leicester Square tube station on the Piccadilly line.
The hotel is steps from Regent Street and Oxford Circus to the north, Trafalgar Square to the south, Covent Garden to the east and Piccadilly Circus to the west.
Rooms have rainforest showers and signature W beds.
Floor-to-ceiling windows give a view of the city.
The screening room's design recalls the inside of a Victorian camera bellows, with plush chairs in velvet, leather, tweed and fur.
W Film Club screens silver screen favourites in the hotel's screening room.
AWAY Spa offers Seabody treatments, including the 90-minute Drift and Dream ritual.
The FIT gym is outfitted with Technogym equipment.
The hotel hosts its signature AMPLIFIED music series and weekly DJ sets.
W Lounge serves South American-inspired dishes made to share.
Pets are welcome, one per room.

highlights.text: The hotel overlooks Leicester Square, the West End and Chinatown.
Rooms feature wall-to-wall mirrors, work desks and playful design features from local artist Jack Irving.
The hotel has a contemporary screening room with 38 red seats.
AWAY Spa offers tailor-made treatments, a sauna and a steam room.
Whatever/Whenever is the hotel's signature service with a 24-hour concierge.

considerations.text: W London does not offer on-site parking.
Rooms at W London do not have a fridge.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
